`[FACT]` In each job, the TBO file faulted on all 4 server launches during draft-decode graph capture (`Memory access fault by GPU node-2`), with both attention backends.
The non-TBO MTP file in the same job faulted on one launch, then passed on the retry. This happened on both ROCm versions.

Both jobs ran sglang [`4003bf10`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/4003bf1077debcca3fccfa6e0d7b56ed584aa727). They used different runners (`…-tcsgf` and `…-g7nqb`) and different images: rocm10 on `-20261108`, rocm724 on `-20261107`.
None of the 14 earlier rocm10 logs has a memory fault. The last pass was Nov 7 16:07 at [`ba590647`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/ba5906471c62e82c0594a617b4d07d9b2c0fd2b3).

details.label: Top hypothesis
details.text: `[LOW]` [#48852](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/48852) ([`de363613`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/de3636131d1727b1397be98a42d58d5db95a0936)), [#48006](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/48006) ([`dadff253`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/dadff253c0aa8c7456b351cb9d2c282a8e513958)), [#48007](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/48007) ([`fcb32746`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/fcb3274646e43c16d70fd83806ebb3a5134d5e81)) and [#48008](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/48008) ([`c24285bd`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/c24285bde97c3e6424cd5d8cb35788889034d8ea)) form a mem_cache refactor stack in the window. It may have changed how the DSV4 draft reads its KV pages. The same fault on two ROCm versions, two images and two runners points at the sglang window, not at one host. **Disconfirming**:
The job runs with `enable_unified_memory=False`, so it does not use the band allocator.
The faulting kernels, the DSV4 backend and the pool files did not change.
The DSpark DSV4-Pro job passed in both runs.

details.label: In-flight fix
details.text: ❌ none found. **Suggested triage**: bisect from [`9d547e19`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/9d547e19ff519f0d1b964b0b1c014d98dc65caf4) with `SGLANG_HACK_FLASHMLA_BACKEND=triton`.
